articles.summary: Pinnacle is the only messaging API that lets you send and receive emoji reactions on SMS, MMS, and RCS messages. One API call. Any emoji. Every channel.
articles.title: Message Reactions: Send and Receive Emoji Reactions via SMS, MMS, and RCS

articles.summary: Pinnacle's bulk messaging lets you send SMS, MMS, or RCS to your entire contact list in a single API call — with multi-sender distribution, one-time or recurring scheduling, and full analytics. Build your audience, hit send, and watch the data roll in.
articles.title: Bulk Messaging: Send SMS, MMS, and RCS to Thousands of Contacts at Once
